title: Local Runtime Observatory
basisStatement: One local command starts the durable control and audit databases, durable S3-compatible object storage, disposable queue and cache services, then gates host processes on deterministic seeding and semantic smoke instead of on open ports alone.

services.label: Control store
services.accessible_label: control store service is durable truth and protects mutable workflow law
safe_rebuild_instructions: Re-run the idempotent postgres-bootstrap phase before host processes start.
Never remove postgres-data unless a full reset was explicitly requested and confirmed.
notes: Local development keeps control and audit semantics separate while using one PostgreSQL cluster for portability.
The control store remains the durable mutation basis for receipts, manifests, outbox, inbox, access, and workflow facts.

services.label: Audit store
services.accessible_label: audit store service is durable truth and preserves append only evidence continuity
safe_rebuild_instructions: Append-only probe rows may be added during bootstrap, but historical rows are never mutated in place.
Durable reset requires the same explicit confirmation as the control store.
notes: Append-only audit truth stays operationally separate from mutable control truth even in local development.
Host processes treat audit continuity as an explicit precondition, not an observability side effect.

services.label: Object storage
services.accessible_label: object storage service is durable truth for immutable bodies and restore archives
safe_rebuild_instructions: Bootstrap recreates buckets idempotently and re-enables versioning on every run.
Do not delete minio-data during a disposable reset because retained evidence and restore archives are durable.
notes: Local object storage mirrors the same bucket taxonomy used by the governed storage contracts.
Provider-local emulation is explicit here: MinIO preserves S3-compatible versioning semantics without inventing cloud vendor state.

services.label: Queue
services.accessible_label: queue service is disposable delivery fabric and rebuilds from outbox truth
safe_rebuild_instructions: Disposable reset may delete rabbitmq-data because queues rebuild from outbox, inbox, interaction, and audit truth.
Never promote broker backlog into legal truth during recovery.
notes: Local RabbitMQ quorum queues preserve the broker-only transport posture from ADR-002 and the messaging inventory.
Queue namespaces stay subordinate to durable outbox and inbox truth.

services.label: Cache
services.accessible_label: cache service is disposable acceleration and purges on partition drift
safe_rebuild_instructions: Disposable reset may delete redis-data because cache and resume state must be derivable from durable truth.
Use purge and rehydrate instead of hand-editing cached rows when partition identity drifts.
notes: Local Redis mirrors the shared-cache and resume-store posture without elevating cached data into durable meaning.
Namespace sentinels are bootstrap evidence only; they never authorize live mutation by themselves.

services.label: App
services.accessible_label: app service is host process gated until schema buckets queues cache and seed checks pass
safe_rebuild_instructions: Host processes start only after semantic readiness passes.
Restarting host processes does not reset durable or disposable substrate data.
notes: Operator web and API remain host-run so local editing stays fast.
Bootstrap blocks them on schema, bucket, queue, cache, fixture, and smoke gates.

services.label: Workers
services.accessible_label: workers service is host process gated until queue audit and smoke checks pass
safe_rebuild_instructions: Workers stay stopped until semantic readiness and smoke checks pass.
A disposable reset requires queue and cache rebuild before workers resume claim loops.
notes: Worker processes remain subordinate to durable truth and the deterministic local seed basis.
Queue or cache loss is recoverable only because worker legality is anchored outside those services.

connections.label: Receipt and audit continuity
connections.summary: Control mutations and append-only audit evidence remain separate durable stores so replay and investigation never depend on mutable queue or cache memory.
connections.accessible_label: Receipt and audit continuity is durable truth from control_store to audit_store

connections.label: Outbox to queue delivery
connections.summary: Queue packets deliver work from persisted outbox or recovery truth and remain disposable transport only.
connections.accessible_label: Outbox to queue delivery is derived transport from control_store to queue

connections.label: Control-to-object binding
connections.summary: Control records bind immutable refs to storage namespaces without promoting bucket paths into the system of record.
connections.accessible_label: Control-to-object binding is durable truth from control_store to object_storage

connections.label: Projection and resume derivation
connections.summary: Shared cache and resume envelopes accelerate reads and reconnection while staying purgeable and subordinate to durable truth.
connections.accessible_label: Projection and resume derivation is disposable acceleration from control_store to cache

connections.label: Worker claim fabric
connections.summary: Workers consume disposable broker transport only after deterministic seeding and smoke gates pass.
connections.accessible_label: Worker claim fabric is derived transport from queue to workers

connections.label: Gateway-bound object delivery
connections.summary: Apps bind current-safe targets and delivery handles to immutable object namespaces without exposing raw storage paths.
connections.accessible_label: Gateway-bound object delivery is durable truth from object_storage to app

connections.label: Read-only cache hydration
connections.summary: Apps may hydrate from cache only under exact partition identity and must block mutation until live legality returns.
connections.accessible_label: Read-only cache hydration is disposable acceleration from cache to app
